newsitem.title: SPAIN: Union may enter talks to end Spain truckers strike.
newsitem.headline: Union may enter talks to end Spain truckers strike.

text.p: The union spearheading a 10-day-old Spanish truckers strike may start its first talks with the government on Saturday, a union spokeswoman said.

Representatives of the union Fedatrans were in contacts with government officials on Saturday morning to discuss the possibility of negotiations that could begin later in the day, the spokeswoman told Reuters.
"At this moment, they are in contact with the government but not negotiating yet," she said.
The strike to demand better labour conditions and lower fuel prices has caused major disruptions to commerce and cross-border traffic this week.
There have also been numerous violent incidents. One striker was killed on Thursday when he ran out in front of a passing French truck to try to stop it.

The government warned on Friday the strike was causing grave damage to the Spanish economy and promised neighbours France and Portugal, the two countries most affected by the strike, it would ensure unimpeded movement on the roads.
